name: shots/missile
description: Ground missile v2 (v20x-ARTPM, hand pixel map — the AI lance never held the contract box, w15-GEN6/w15-GEN7L): a full-bleed 12x5 finned rocket (AR 2.4 inside the 1.6..3.8 window) in the v1 palette (the shots-v2 reuse law) — white-lit top flank, steel mid, dark belly and fin rings, red nose band; the fly frame swaps the grey smoke nub for a compact amber flame and the core row stays whole both frames. Reads as a rocket, not a smooth bolt — separates it from torpedo, basic and twin (w15-WEAPONLOOK § 6). v1 keeps its 8x3 shape.
